content:
There is a specific kind of joy in buying silver during Aadi. It is not about the money or even the piece really, it is the ritual of it. The season telling you it is okay to want something nice.

GIVA gets that. Buy 1 Get 1 on silver right now, which means you are basically obligated to pick two. I do not make the rules, Aadi does.
comment: Seasonal buying works because jewellery often sits at the intersection of emotion and habit. Brands that understand the ritual can build trust beyond just discounts.
